name: Lina Gálvez - § 1, point a - Am 3
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council concerning the EU priorities for the 70th session of the UN Commission on the Status of Women
part_text: (a) reaffirm the EU’s strong commitment to gender equality and guarantee the full implementation of women’s and girls’ rights in all aspects of EU external action, including development, trade, and foreign policy, through the conditionality of Neighbourhood, Development and International Cooperation Instrument (NDICI) aid and external European action on unconditional compliance with equality, and an inclusive and intersectional approach that challenges gender stereotypes and is based on the principle of non-discrimination, in order to swiftly advance gender equality;
